# Algorithm reference only

Source: https://github.com/abmoRobotics/RLRoverLab/tree/578906ad5c3383087aeec038be82b87e05d4ee2c

The unedited snapshots and SHA-256 manifest document the navigation functions, network architecture,
PPO configuration and target/spawn sampling used by this migration. Apache-2.0 licensing is retained.
No reference robot, terrain, simulator, USD file or texture is included or used.

Runtime ports under `space_robotics_nav/vendor` retain function/class bodies. Isaac Lab imports and
model utility import paths are adapted; target mesh input comes from this project's original Gazebo assets.
